message: ダンス＆レボリューション
The day of the dance workshop.
The one who stepped forward, pushing aside the unreliable Student Council President, was--

name: Helena
message: 「Today, I've brought in a special instructor!!」
With Helena taking the female role and Riesling taking the male role, they perform a demonstration dance.
However, the two of them danced so magnificently and beautifully that everyone was envious, and above all, it was at an incredibly high level.
Naturally, no one was able to imitate them...

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, everyone. Let's dance along to the music~~♪」
Under Ria-senpai's guidance, everyone learned a dance they could easily enjoy.
